The grants sanctioning bureau then issues a fresh sanction order cancelling the earlier one and submits it with the bill to Finance Division for payment. In contrast, for cases pending in grant sanctioning bureaus for obtaining competent authority sanction, the sanction for the financial year 2018-19 must be obtained first, and then the sanction order issued and payment made as per usual procedure.

To,
The Directors/Heads of all CSIR Labs/Instts/Units

Sub: Accounting methodology for recruitment exam related financial transactions by CSIR HQrs and CSIR Labs/Instts/Units -reg

Madam/Sir,

The accounting of financial transactions (Receipts and Payments) on recruitment exams has been engaging the attention of CSIR Hqrs for quite some time. To address the issues involved, the following accounting methodology has been decided for projectization and carrying out the financial transactions on recruitment exam related expenditure: -

1. In place of the existing system of receipt of application fee for recruitment to any post being credited to the c-code R06713 (Application Fee), a separate/distinct GDA Project may be opened in AMS for each recruitment exam.
2. Financial transactions (both receipts and payments) for a particular recruitment exam may be carried out in the related GDA Project, specifically opened for the exam, under the BH R90807 and P90807 for Receipts and Payments respectively. Receipts or Payments pertaining to one recruitment exam cannot be transacted in another recruitment exam project.
3. In case of expenditure exceeding the receipts in a particular recruitment exam project, the excess expenditure shall be met out of :-
   a. Regular Budget Heads of Govt. Grant in case of Labs/Instts/Units, and
   b. BH P80507 in case of CSIR HQrs.

This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority.

Yours faithfully,

[Signature]

CIRCULAR

Subject: Political clearance from MEA for visit of foreign nationals to CSIR Labs/Instts for various S&T cooperation purposes.

The undersigned is directed to inform that the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt of India has launched an online portal (conference.epolclearance.gov.in) to facilitate grant of political clearances to foreign nationals to attend/participate in conference/seminar/workshops/sports etc events being organized in India. In this regard, all the CSIR Labs/Instts are requested to kindly visit the link below for registration to apply for the political clearance from the Ministry of External Affairs for visit of any foreign nationals to CSIR Labs/Instts for various purposes:
https://conference.epolclearance.gov.in/

In case of any query, please contact the following:
a) For event related queries: Coordination Section at:
Tel No. 011-23088129
Email: socoord@mea.gov.in; socoord1@mea.gov.in; socoord2@mea.gov.in

b) For technical queries: Technical Cell at:
Tel No. 011-23088371
Email: egov.egit@mea.gov.in

Accordingly, henceforth all CSIR Labs/Instts are required to apply to the MEA directly as per procedure mentioned above, for seeking the political clearance from the MEA in case of:
i. visit of all foreigners/Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) to CSIR Labs/ Instts for various S&T cooperation purposes; and
ii. visit of all foreign participants/delegates/experts etc to CSIR Labs/Instts in connection with any International Conference/Symposium/Workshop/Seminar/Summit/Conclave or any such International event being hosted/organised by CSIR Labs/Instts.

Prior approval of the competent authority should be obtained separately from CSIR Headquarters(HQ) through ISTAD before the aforementioned foreign nationals/OCI are allowed to visit CSIR labs/Instts. Likewise, in the case of International Conference/Symposium/Workshop/Seminar /Summit/Conclave or any such International event being hosted/organised by CSIR Labs/Instts, separate and prior approval of the competent authority at CSIR HQ is to be sought mandatorily by the concerned CSIR lab apart from political clearance from the MEA. In case of any difficulty/doubts in applying for political clearance from the MEA, necessary assistance can be sought from ISTAD, CSIR HQ.

This issues with the approval of the Head ISTAD.

Sub: Guidelines for Transfer and Posting of Gr.III Engineers from Gr.III(1) to Gr.III(7) for all CSIR National Labs/Instts, CSIR-Hqrs. and other CSIR establishments across India-modification thereof.- reg  

Attention is invited to the O.M. No 11-17(1)/transfer Policy/2017-Engg dated 09.05.2018 vide which Guidelines for Transfer and Posting of Gr.III Engineers from Gr.III(1) to Gr.III(7) for all CSIR National Labs/Instts, CSIR-HQ and other CSIR establishments across India were notified.  

In terms of Para 5(ii) of the aforesaid Guidelines, ESD CSIR Hqrs. is the Nodal office for implementation of rotation/transfer of engineers across CSIR labs/Instts. The matter has since been reviewed and DG, CSIR has approved that hereinafter, instead of ESD, HR-II Division of CSIR Hqrs. will look after the transfer of engineers.  

Further, in terms of Para 5(iii) of the aforesaid guidelines, which states that ESD, CSIR Hqrs. shall maintain the database of rotation/transfer of engineers/technical officers and prepare a suitable monitoring mechanism. DG, CSIR has approved that instead of ESD CSIR, now HR-II Division of CSIR Hqrs. will maintain the database of rotation/transfer of engineers/technical officers and prepare a suitable monitoring mechanism.  

Therefore, the aforesaid guidelines stands modified to the above extent.

2. Recently, in a high level review meeting on I-STEM, a novel scheme of Department of Science and Technology called SUPREME came to our notice. Under this scheme, funds are made available for maintenance/ upgradation/repair of the AIFs (Analytical Instrumentation Facility) in ERIs (Educational & Research Institutes). It has, therefore, been decided that all CSIR Labs/Units should take full advantage of this Scheme.

3. As the first step towards this, labs. /Units have to identify eligible equipment to avail funds under the Scheme. A copy of the SUPREME Scheme is enclosed for reference.

CSIR COMPLEX, LIBRARY AVENUE, PUSA, NEW DELHI – 110 012  

No. Advisory/2023-24/EMR I                                                                                   Date: 11-04-2025  

OFFICE MEMORANDUM  

Attention is invited to the following issues being faced with regard to the Fellowships/Associateships of the Research Fellows/Associates hosted at various Universities/Institutes/Colleges:  

1. Many Research Fellows have not been complying with the timelines for submission of documents towards their upgradation/continuation/extension, as stipulated in the relevant guidelines and are submitting their documents after the lapse of the stipulated timelines.  
2. It is clearly mentioned in the CSIR guidelines that prior approval of CSIR is mandatory for transfer of fellowship from one University/Institute/College to another University/Institute/College. Despite these instructions, many Research Fellows have been leaving their PhD programme/CSIR fellowships from their current Institutes without obtaining prior approval of CSIR and have also been joining PhD programmes at other Institutes, that too without prior approval of CSIR. Similarly, the Universities/Institutes/Colleges have been allowing the Fellows to leave the fellowship on transfer without obtaining specific approval from CSIR while also allowing some Fellows to join on transfer without ascertaining that prior approval for transfer has been obtained by the Fellow from CSIR. This is in complete violation of the CSIR norms.  
3. 1. कई शोध अध्येता प्रारंभिक दिशा-निर्देशों में निर्धारित अनुसार अपने उपस्थापन/विस्तार के लिए दस्तावेज जमा करने की समयसीमा का पालन नहीं कर रहे हैं और निर्धारित समयसीमा समाप्त होने के बाद अपने दस्तावेज जमा कर रहे हैं।  

2. हालाँकि सीएसआईआर दिशानिर्देशों में यह स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेख किया गया है कि कुछ विश्वविद्यालय/संस्थान/कॉलेजों में विश्वविद्यालय/संस्थान/कॉलेजों के फेलोशिप के हस्तांतरण के लिए सीएसआईआर की पूर्व स्वीकृति आवश्यक है, फिर भी कई शोध अध्येता सीएसआईआर की पूर्व स्वीकृति प्राप्त किए बिना अपने वर्तमान संस्थान से पीएचडी/पोस्टडॉक्टरल फेलोशिप का स्थानांतरण कर रहे हैं और उस संस्थान में पोर्टल्स अपडेट नहीं कर रहे हैं, यह भी सीएसआईआर के दिशानिर्देशों के खिलाफ है।  

3. यद्यपि सीएसआईआर के दिशा-निर्देशों में यह प्रावधान है कि फेलो को संस्थान में प्रवेश के अनुमोदन के केवल गाइड के माध्यम से ही सीएसआईआरएचआरडी के साथ पत्र-व्यवहार करना होगा, फिर भी शोध फेलो निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर क्लेम्स प्रस्तुत करने हेतु प्राधिकृतियों का ईमेल कर रहे हैं।  

4. न्यू एम्प्लॉयमेंट पोर्टल पर अपने ज्वाइनिंग रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने समय फेलो/वर्कर/कर्मी द्वारा पर्याप्त सावधानी नहीं बरती जाती है, जिससे कारण डाटाबेस में गलत जानकारी दर्ज जाती है।  

5. जहाँ भी आवश्यक हो, उपयुक्त प्रमाण पत्र विश्वविद्यालयों/संस्थानों/कॉलेजों के लेटरहेड पर प्रस्तुत नहीं किए जाते।  

अतः, सभी संबंधितों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे उपर्युक्त का ध्यान रखें और साथ ही इस विषय पर निर्देशों/शर्तों का अनुपालन भी करें क्योंकि इन मामलों में गैर-अनुपालन से प्रतिकूल परिणाम हो सकते हैं, जिसमें फेलोशिप दावों की प्रक्रिया में देरी/क्लेम्स की समाप्ति आदि शामिल है।

OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Sub: Procedure to be observed by the Departmental Promotion Committees (DPCs) – Model Calendar for DPCs – Relevant year up to which APARs are to be considered and Model Calendar for conducting DPCs – regarding.

The undersigned is directed to invite reference to the Department of Personnel and Training OM of even number dated 8th September, 1998 prescribing a ‘Model Calendar’ for DPCs in order to ensure that DPCs are convened in advance and approved select panels are ready on the date of commencement of the relevant vacancy year and that the last date for sending complete proposal to the UPSC is 15 July (in ACC cases) and 31 July (in non-ACC cases) of the year preceding the vacancy year.

2. Reference is further invited to the Department of Personnel and Training OM of even number dated 16th June, 2000 wherein it was prescribed/clarified that only such ACRs (now APARs) should be considered which became available during the year immediately preceding the vacancy/panel year irrespective of the date of convening of the DPC. In other words, for the vacancy/panel year 2000-01, it was prescribed that ACRs (now APARs) up to the year 1998-99 (five years preceding T – 1st year) are required to be considered. Accordingly, for the vacancy year 2017-18, APARs up to the year 2015-16 are required to be considered.

3. Reference is also invited to the Department of Personnel and Training OM No. 22011/1/2005- Estt(A)-(Pt-II) dated 23rd July, 2009 on the subject ‘Preparation and Maintenance of APARs’ wherein a time schedule for preparation/completion of APAR has been prescribed. As per this schedule, entire APAR process is to be completed by 30th November of the year following the completion of time period of APAR year.

4. As per the extant instructions, say for vacancy year 2017-18, complete proposal to the UPSC has to be sent by 15 July, 2016 (in ACC cases) and 31 July, 2016 (in non-ACC cases) with APARs up to the year 2015-16. However, the entire process of recording APAR for the year 2015-16 is complete by 30th November, 2016 only. After the issue of guidelines regarding time schedule for completion of APAR, the time lines make it practically impossible to make the last APAR (the APAR of the year immediately preceding T-1th year) available for DPCs, i.e., the APAR for the year 2015-16 does not attain finality and thus may not be available before sending proposal for DPC for vacancy year 2017-18. In this background, the instructions regarding the procedure for convening DPCs have been reviewed in consultation with UPSC.
--- PAGE 3 ---
5. In order to streamline the process of timely convening of DPCs, it has been now decided that henceforth, the following changes may be effected in the DPC procedure in partial modification of this Department OM No. 22011/5/86-Estt.(D) dated 10.4.89, OM No. 22011/9/98-Estt.(D) dated 16.6.2000, OM No. 22011/9/98-Estt.(D) dated 8.9.98 and OM No. 22011/6/2013-Estt.(D) dated 28.5.2014 (crucial date of eligibility):-

(i) The vacancy year may be shifted to Calendar Year from the year 2018 onwards, wherever the financial year based vacancy year being followed now.
(ii) The crucial date of eligibility will be 1st of January of the Vacancy year w.e.f 2019.
(iii) The APARs for five years preceding T-2nd year may be taken as reckoning APARs, i.e. for the vacancy year 2019 (January 2019 to December, 2019), the reckoning APARs shall be 2016-17, 2015-16, 2014-15, 2013-14 and 2012-13.
(iv) The year of 2018 being the transitional year, the vacancy period shall be from 1st April 2018 to 31st December, 2018. The reckoning APARs for this vacancy year shall be 2015-16, 2014-15, 2013-14, 2012-13 and 2011-12. The crucial date of eligibility shall be 1st April, 2018 for the transitional year.

6. Ministries/Departments are requested to give wide circulation to these instructions for guidance in the matter and also to ensure strict adherence to the time-schedule prescribed as per the 'Model Calendar' for DPCs.

Office Memorandum  

Subject:- Revalidation of sanctions pertaining to year 2017-18 and pending for payment as on 31.03.2018.  

This is regarding revalidation of sanctions pertaining to the year 2017-18 and pending for payment as on 31.03.2018. In all such cases, IFD concurrence had already been accorded during the year 2017-18 but payment could not be made in following circumstances. In all these cases, there will be no requirement of fresh IFD concurrence if the proposed amount and beneficiary are same.  

1. Cases where sanctions on file has been accorded by competent authority upto 31.03.2018.  
In this category, there will be following types of cases:  
(A) Drafts sanction order has been approved by FD-III and FD diary no. has been allotted during year 2017-18 but final sanction order could not be issued upto 31.03.2018.  
(B) Final sanction order has been issued upto 31.03.2018, but bill has not been sent to Finance Division by grants sanctioning bureau.  
(C) Final sanction order has been issued upto 31.03.2018 and bill has been sent to FD by grants sanctioning bureau but payment could not be made by Finance Division.  

In above cases (A, B & C), draft sanction order or final sanction order with bill is to be returned by FD-III section to the concerned grants sanctioning bureau after changing the year to 2018-19 from 2017-18 and also after cancellation of earlier diary no. & allotment of new diary no. of year 2018-19. The grants sanctioning bureau will issue fresh sanction order by cancelling the earlier one, if any, and submit the same with the bill to FD for making the payment.  

(D) Cases pending in FD-III for allotment of FD diary no. and vetting of draft sanction order.  
In such cases, FD-III will make necessary changes in the draft sanction order to make it valid for year 2018-19 instead of year 2017-18 and allot FD diary no. of current financial year. After that file is to be returned to the concerned section for issuance of the final sanction order and preparation of grants-in-aid bill as per usual procedure.  

Cont....  

[Signature]

-Page2-

(E) Cases pending in grant sanctioning bureaus for preparation of draft sanction order for vetting by FD-III and allotment of FD diary no. after obtaining the sanction of competent authority during year 2017-18.

In all such cases, the draft sanction order is to be prepared by grant sanctioning bureaus for financial year 2018-19 without seeking revised sanction of sanctioning authority for current financial year.

2. Cases pending in grant sanctioning bureaus for obtaining the sanction of competent authority.

In such cases sanction of competent authority for financial year 2018-19 is to be obtained and sanction order is to be issued and payment to be made as per usual procedure.

All the grants sanctioning bureaus Regional Offices and Finance Division, UGC may please note the above decisions.

It may also be ensured by the grants sanctioning bureaus, Regional Offices and Finance Division that all payments as stated in Para 1 (A) to (E) above and previous years pending sanctioned payments, if any, be made before the start of current year payments.

OFFICE MEMORANDUM  

Subject:— Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2008 – Date of next increment in the revised pay structure under Rule 10 of the CCS(RP) Rules, 2008.

In accordance with the provisions contained in Rule 10 of the CCS (RP) Rules, 2008, there will be a uniform date of annual increment, viz. 1st July of every year. Employees completing 6 months and above in the revised pay structure as on 1st of July will be eligible to be granted the increment. The first increment after fixation of pay on 1.1.2006 in the revised pay structure will be granted on 1.7.2006 for those employees for whom the date of next increment was between 1st July, 2006 to 1st January, 2007.

2. The Staff Side has represented on this issue and has requested that those employees who were due to get their annual increment between February to June during 2006 may be granted one increment on 01.01.2006 in the pre-revised scale.

3. On further consideration and in exercise of the powers available under CCS(RP) Rules, 2008, the President is pleased to decide that in relaxation of stipulation under Rule 10 of these Rules, those central government employees who were due to get their annual increment between February to June during 2006 may be granted one increment on 1.1.2006 in the pre-revised pay scale as a one time measure and thereafter will get the next increment in the revised pay structure on 1.7.2006 as per Rule 10 of CCS(RP) Rules, 2008. The pay of the eligible employees may be re-fixed accordingly.

4. In so far as the persons serving in the Indian Audit and Account Department are concerned, these orders are issued in consultation with the Comptroller & Auditor General of India.

Subject:- Grant of increased rate of Washing Allowance to common categories of Group ‘C’ and ‘D’ employees of various Ministries/ Departments.  

Consequent upon the decisions taken by the Government on the recommendations made by the Sixth Central Pay Commission and in supersession of this Department’s O.M. No.14/9/95-JCA dated 12.12.2000 on the subject of Washing Allowance, the President is pleased to order that the rate of Washing Allowance will be revised from the existing Rs.30/- per month to Rs.60/- per month for all common categories of Group ‘C’ and ‘D’ employees who have been supplied with uniforms.
